findings.summary: Cross-wave: 16 TS5097 errors from .ts-extension imports gate the @medbridge/api typecheck; tsc -b exits 1.
findings.suggested_fix: Follow-up wave: convert .ts to .js in db/client.ts(5,6), db/schema.ts(1), modules/auth/repo.ts(4,5), modules/auth/service.ts(29,34,35), service.test.ts(71,73), seed/main.ts(1,2,3,4). main.ts itself is clean.

findings.summary: loadEnv(process.env) at boot is redundant with eager singleton in shared/env.ts line 26; both validate on import.
findings.suggested_fix: Either remove the eager `export const env = loadEnv()` from shared/env.ts (preferred, makes DI testable per agent memory project_env_eager_load) OR drop the explicit loadEnv() call in main.ts. Today both run.

findings.summary: buildApp accepts env via parameter but ignores it (_env); the app reads env transitively through module-level singletons.
findings.suggested_fix: Either thread env into createAuthService / db client constructors for full DI (matches buildApp(env) factory pattern) or drop the unused parameter and document that env is a process-level singleton.

findings.summary: cors({ origin: '*', credentials: true }) is silently rejected by browsers; breaks cookie-based auth per ARCHITECTURE §5.4.
findings.suggested_fix: Narrow CORS origin to the SPA host via env (CORS_ORIGIN) — browsers ignore Access-Control-Allow-Credentials when Allow-Origin is '*'. Cookie auth (session/refresh/csrf) silently fails in browsers.
